name: resonite-mcp
description: Complete Resonite social VR platform control with avatar management, world building, ProtoFlux scripting, WorldLabs Marble import, and real-time social interactions.

worldlabs_import.description: Download SPZ/GLB from worldlabs-mcp proxy, import via ResoniteLink + OSC. No mocks.

worldlabs_osc_receiver.description: Background OSC server on port 9001 listening for /worldlabs/import. Auto-triggers download + import.

worldlabs_protoflux_graph.description: JSON ProtoFlux graph template for OSC → StringSplit → HttpGet → ImportSplat pipeline.

resonite_platform_detection.description: Detect Steam/Standalone Resonite installations and running status via psutil.

blender_import.description: Export from blender-mcp, download, import into Resonite via ResoniteLink.

unity_avatar_sync.description: Download avatar model from unity3d-mcp, import into Resonite via ResoniteLink.
